name: architecture_analysis
description: Scores a project or module against architecture quality dimensions: cohesion, coupling, layer separation, dependency direction, testability, and documentation coverage. Output feeds the planner's risk_analysis to detect architecture regressions early.

inputs.name: module_id
inputs.description: AIOS-MODULE-NNNNNN to analyze. If omitted, analyzes the entire project.

inputs.name: brain_snapshot
inputs.description: Knowledge graph slice from AIOS-MODULE-000005. If omitted, runs a shallow analysis.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: { score_0to100, dimensions: [{name, score, finding}], risks: string[], recommendations: string[] }

side_effects: Caches the report in runtime cache manager under key based on module_id + brain_snapshot hash

error_codes.message: The given module_id is not installed.
error_codes.recovery: Return partial report for root manifest only; list installed modules.

error_codes.message: Brain graph is stale; analysis is best-effort.
error_codes.recovery: Flag staleness in the report; do not block.

examples: module_id=AIOS-MODULE-000002 -> report with coupling/layer/cohesion scores for the kernel contracts.
